latent_action_quantizer.What is a latent action, and how do LAPA: Cover the encoder as an inverse-dynamics model over a frame pair, the decoder as a world model, the code index as a pseudo-label the VLM predicts, and the later swap to a real action head on labelled data.
latent_action_quantizer.Why does a VQ-VAE need a special trick t: Start from argmin having no useful derivative. Explain what x + stop_grad(q - x) evaluates to in the forward pass and what its gradient is in the backward pass, and what it leaves untrained.
latent_action_quantizer.In straight-through VQ, which parameters: Trace where stop_grad sits in each term. Discuss codes that never move without the codebook term, and an encoder whose outputs drift away from the codes without commitment; mention the role of beta.
latent_action_quantizer.Write the NSVQ substitution and explain: Write the replacement of q - x by a scaled random direction, then follow the gradient through the residual norm back to the chosen code. Compare the forward distance to the true quantization error.
latent_action_quantizer.How do you detect and repair dead codes,: Cover usage counting over a window, a threshold on the usage rate, copying live codes with a small perturbation, and when to stop. Relate exp(entropy) of usage to the effective number of codes.
latent_action_quantizer.Quantizing the difference of frame featu: Contrast a code driven by change alone with one that can also encode scene appearance. Discuss camera motion and distractors, and how UniVLA's language-conditioned stage tries to separate task-relevant dynamics.
latent_action_quantizer.Discrete latent action codes versus GR00: Compare a token head with cross-entropy over a small vocabulary to regressing a continuous vector. Discuss information lost by quantization, compatibility with VLM token heads, and multimodality.
